(()=>{if(document.querySelector("[data-anatomy-result]").textContent!=="—")throw Error("empty start");if([...document.querySelectorAll("[data-pbw-group^=measure]")].some(e=>e.style.display!=="none"))throw Error("stale blank geometry");return "Blank state hides all six measures";})()

(()=>{window.baseMarkup=document.querySelector("[data-pbw-group=measure0]").innerHTML;window.baseSwitch=document.querySelector("[data-pbw-group=selector]").getAttribute("transform");if(document.querySelector("#field-height").value!=="175"||document.querySelector("#anatomy-height").value!=="175")throw Error("shared preset");return "175 cm male: PBW 70.566 kg, six equal measures total 423.396 ml";})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector("[data-pbw-group=measure0]").innerHTML===window.baseMarkup||document.querySelector("[data-pbw-group=selector]").getAttribute("transform")===window.baseSwitch)throw Error("sex geometry insensitive");return "Female formula changes all fills and the physical shuttle";})()
(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector("#field-height").value.replace(",","."))<=191)throw Error("pointer drag");return "Pointer capture drag changes height";})()
(()=>{if(document.querySelector("#anatomy-sex").value!=="0")throw Error("switch keyboard");return "Keyboard formula switch changes shared sex";})()
(()=>{if(document.querySelector("#anatomy-height").value!=="180")throw Error("main to anatomy");return "Main form updates carousel and Anatomy field";})()
(()=>{if(document.querySelector("#field-height").value!=="185")throw Error("anatomy to main");return "Anatomy updates main form";})()

(()=>{const svg=document.querySelector(".pbw-svg"),h=document.querySelector(".pbw-handle rect");const touch=new Touch({identifier:1,target:h,clientX:1,clientY:1});const start=new TouchEvent("touchstart",{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:[touch]});h.dispatchEvent(start);const move=new TouchEvent("touchmove",{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:[touch]});svg.dispatchEvent(move);const end=new TouchEvent("touchcancel",{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:[]});svg.dispatchEvent(end);const free=new TouchEvent("touchstart",{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:[touch]});svg.dispatchEvent(free);const freeMove=new TouchEvent("touchmove",{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:[touch]});svg.dispatchEvent(freeMove);svg.dispatchEvent(new TouchEvent("touchend",{bubbles:true,touches:[]}));if(!start.defaultPrevented||!move.defaultPrevented||free.defaultPrevented||freeMove.defaultPrevented)throw Error("native touch lock");return "Native touchstart and touchmove cancelled only for control; touchcancel releases page scrolling";})()

(()=>{if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error("horizontal overflow");const rs=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-pbw-hit]")].map(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect());if(rs.some(r=>r.width<43.9||r.height<43.9))throw Error("44px targets");if(rs[0].right>rs[1].left&&rs[0].left<rs[1].right&&rs[0].bottom>rs[1].top&&rs[0].top<rs[1].bottom)throw Error("overlap targets");return "No sideways scroll, two distinct 44px controls";})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector("[data-anatomy-result]").textContent!=="—"||[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-pbw-group^=measure]")].some(e=>e.style.display!=="none")||!document.querySelector(".pbw-panel [role=alert]"))throw Error("registry validation");return "Nonpositive PBW rejected by original registry validation, no stale geometry";})()
(()=>{window.__pbwObserver.disconnect();if(window.__pbwMutations)throw Error("idle figure keeps redrawing");return "Settled figure performs no animation writes";})()
